propositions: A ticket directory containing no events causes the plan-relation reducer to error and return INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets in the same epic.
Event-less directories are created by process death during the write window (makedirs to atomic rename) and are invisible to git because git cannot track empty directories.
The reducer walks the store directory listing and fails when encountering a directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event, rather than tolerating and skipping it.

The plan-relation snapshot must be tolerant of event-less ticket directories by skipping them with a warning and proceeding with related tickets, fixing existing broken clones that cannot be repaired by pulling.

The writer should continue creating the ticket directory before its first event to avoid race conditions under concurrent multi-session writes, with reader-side tolerance handling the resulting artifacts.
